before: Localizes a captured execution when asked "replay a parser crash", "trace this bad value", or "inspect a failing input". Before routing debugging, Ask the user: one execution, wider causes, or missing test controls? Not for system-wide cause or change-impact analysis (see analyzability) or adding test seams (see testability).
after: Localizes a reproducible execution when asked "replay a crash", "find the first bad branch", or "inspect captured inputs". For a wrong value alone, Ask the user: trace one execution or analyze sources and dependencies? Not for system-wide cause or change-impact analysis (see analyzability) or adding test seams (see testability).

before: Specifies required operations when asked "add report downloads", "add queued-job cancellation", or "list required operations". Before routing feature complaints, Ask the user: absent operation, broken behavior, or task mismatch? Not for wrong existing behavior (see correctness), task fit (see suitability), or achieved outcomes (see effectiveness).
after: Specifies absent operations when asked "add downloads", "cancel queued jobs", or "define supported actions". For a missing feature, Ask the user: absent action, wrong behavior, or task mismatch? Not for wrong existing behavior (see correctness), task fit (see suitability), or achieved outcomes (see effectiveness).

before: Restores state when asked "restore orders", "check recovered checkout", or "avoid replay". Ask the user: restoration, write retention, or operation during faults? Not for operation during faults (see fault-failure-tolerance), acknowledged-state retention (see durability), or essential mission continuity (see survivability).
after: Restores state when asked "check restored orders", "verify replay", or "test recovery". For getting service back, Ask the user: restore state, retain writes, or sustain the mission? Not for operation during faults (see fault-failure-tolerance), acknowledged-state retention (see durability), or essential mission continuity (see survivability).

before: Substitutes components when asked "retire an old backend", "preserve replacement callers", or "migrate provider state". Before routing provider changes, Ask the user: replace, coexist, or retain behind a wrapper? Not for coexistence alone (see compatibility).
after: Substitutes implementations when asked "retire this backend", "migrate its saved state", or "preserve existing callers". For a bare swap request, Ask the user whether the implementation is retired, kept behind an adapter, or run alongside another. Not for coexistence alone (see compatibility).

before: Shares an artifact across contexts when asked "decouple a checker from HTTP", "share validation code", or "remove a copied helper". Ask the user which artifact and new consumer must share code before routing reuse. Not for broadening an abstraction family (see generality) or joining stage contracts (see composability).
after: Shares one artifact when asked "reuse this exact checker", "remove web dependencies", or "share validation logic". Before routing use elsewhere, Ask the user: same code, broader input model, or joined stages? Not for broadening an abstraction family (see generality) or joining stage contracts (see composability).

before: Explains action context when asked "explain this control", "explain this action now", or "label this object". Ask the user: state/action cues or a separate explanation? Not for later notifications (see communicativeness), standalone explanations (see comprehensibility), or backend diagnosis (see observability).
after: Explains state/actions when asked "explain disabled submit", "label pending work", or "name this record". For screen help, Ask the user: current state/actions or standalone explanation? Not for later notifications (see communicativeness), standalone explanations (see comprehensibility), or backend diagnosis (see observability).

before: Checks continued value when asked "review upkeep", "weigh ongoing obligations", or "plan retirement". Ask the user: long-term value, budget fit, or initial feasibility? Not for initial delivery (see feasibility), spending cap alone (see affordability), or environmental objectives (see sustainability).
after: Reviews continued value when asked "review renewal", "weigh upkeep against value", or "set an exit gate". For bare worth/keep/retire questions, Ask the user: value over time, budget fit, or delivery feasibility? Not for initial delivery (see feasibility), spending cap alone (see affordability), or environmental objectives (see sustainability).
